css-mediaquery: BSD 3-clause text in its LICENSE file (Yahoo), OSI approved; the package metadata only says BSD. Needed by react-admin.
require-like@0.1.2: MIT text in its License file (Felix Geisendörfer); the package metadata has no license field. Needed by Docusaurus (through eval).
config-chain@1.1.13: MIT text in its LICENCE file (Dominic Tarr); the package metadata only gives a license object without an SPDX id. Needed by Docusaurus (through update-notifier).
caniuse-lite: CC-BY-4.0 browser support data, not code. Read only while the docs site is built (browserslist) and absent from the published pages.
mdn-data: CC0-1.0 CSS reference data, not code. Read only while the docs site is built (css-tree) and absent from the published pages.
spdx-exceptions: CC-BY-3.0 SPDX exception identifier data from The Linux Foundation, not software. Bundled through npm by the optional OpenClaw runtime; source https://github.com/kemitchell/spdx-exceptions.json. Attribution retained in NOTICE. Data exception approved by the project owner.
spdx-license-ids: CC0-1.0 SPDX licence identifier data, not software. Bundled through npm by the optional OpenClaw runtime; source https://github.com/jslicense/spdx-license-ids. Data exception approved by the project owner.
npm@12.2.2: Artistic-2.0 application, bundled unmodified by the optional OpenClaw runtime. LICENSE verified in npm/cli v12.2.2 and the installed artifact; its bundled dependencies retain their own licences. Scoped exception; not an extension of the repository-wide allowlist.
